Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. And 2 Others
Counsel for Applicant :- Rajesh Kumar Gautam,Anup Kumar Singh

Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Gajendra Kumar,J.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant and learned A.G.A for the State as also perused the record.

This application under Section 482 Cr.P.C. has been filed seeking direction to the court concerned to expedite the trial of Case No. 283/IX/99 (Smt. Rajkumari Vs. Vinod Kumar and others), under sections 494, 120B, 498A, 406, 506 IPC, P.S. Raya, District Mathura.

entities.text: Case No. 283/IX/99 (Smt. Rajkumari Vs. Vinod Kumar and others)
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Considering the fact that the case has remained pending since 1999.

Without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, this application is finally disposed of with a direction to the court below to decide the aforesaid case in accordance with law, as expeditiously as possible, without granting any unnecessary or long adjournments to either of the parties, preferably within a period of six months from the date of production of a certified copy of this order, if there is no other legal impediment.
